questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Wild animals on the road (next 2 km)

questions.explanation: Steep descent (W323): allow for a longer stopping distance, especially when heavily laden.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W323 (p.28)

questions.question: Match each vehicle to its maximum overall length.
questions.explanation: Lengths: articulated 18,5 m; combination 22 m; other vehicles 12,5 m; trailer under 12 000 kg GVM 8 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.30 (p.24)

questions.question: A bracket on a vehicle may not project more than ____ beyond the widest part of the vehicle.
questions.explanation: No bracket may project more than 150 mm beyond the widest part of the vehicle (mirrors and indicators excluded).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.35 (p.26)

questions.question: Which controls are used when changing from one gear to another?
questions.explanation: The clutch (8) and the gear lever (6).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Under which condition may a driver use a cellphone while driving?

options.text: If the call is shorter than one minute
Only if it is affixed to the vehicle or used hands-free (e.g. headgear) so that it is not held
When stopped at a red traffic light while holding the phone

questions.explanation: Reg 308A allows use only if the phone is affixed to the vehicle (or part of its fixtures) or adapted as headgear, so the driver does not hold it.
questions.manualRef: National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000, Reg 308A; NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.52 (p.34)

questions.question: Put these steps for changing DOWN a gear in a manual car in the correct order.

options.text: Release clutch slowly to contact point while accelerating
Brake if necessary to the appropriate speed

questions.explanation: LMV Module 24 (gear changing down, manual transmission).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 24 (p.45)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Taxis only"?
questions.explanation: Taxis only (R118): the road or part of the road is set aside for taxis.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R118 (p.7)

questions.question: This sign means: "One-way roadway to the left".
questions.explanation: False. Yield at traffic circle (R2.2): yield to vehicles in the circle or that will cross their yield line before you cross yours; the driver who reaches the yield line first may proceed first. ("One-way roadway to the left" is the meaning of R4.1.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R2.2 (p.5)

questions.question: A ____ line painted along the edge of the road means no parking.
questions.explanation: No parking line (RM13) is yellow; you may stop for short periods but may not park.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM13 (p.51)

questions.question: This sign means: "Unauthorised vehicles prohibited".
questions.explanation: Unauthorised vehicles prohibited (R208): do not proceed past the sign without special permission.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R208 (p.12)

questions.question: Before braking, what should a motorcyclist check?

options.text: The blind spot over the shoulder

questions.explanation: Brake lights are considered a signal; the rear-view mirrors shall be checked before braking commences. No blind spot should be checked before braking.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Motor Cycles manual Part 1, Module 6 (p.23)

questions.question: What must you do at this marking?

options.text: Do not stop in the box, and only enter if you can drive through
Park in the box for up to 5 minutes
Stop inside the box when the light is red

questions.explanation: Box junction (RM10): do not stop in the demarcated box; make sure you can drive through before entering.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM10 (p.51)

questions.question: You must carry your learner's or driving licence with you in the vehicle when driving.
questions.explanation: No person shall drive unless he or she keeps such licence with him or her in the vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.2 (p.13)

questions.question: A person aged ____ or older must submit a medical certificate with an application for a learner's licence.
questions.explanation: An applicant aged 65 or older must submit a medical certificate on form MC.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.4 (p.14)

questions.question: What is a "pedestrian crossing" where no crossing is marked by a sign?

options.text: The portion of the road at an intersection within the prolongation of the kerb line and adjacent boundary line
Only the area within 50 m of an intersection
Any part of the road where people usually cross
There is no crossing unless it is marked

questions.explanation: Where no crossing is designated by a sign, the pedestrian crossing is the portion of the road at an intersection within the prolongation or connection of the kerb line and adjacent boundary line.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.7)

questions.question: A stop lamp lighting up shows that the vehicle is slowing down and may stop.
questions.explanation: When a stop lamp is illuminated, this indicates that the vehicle is decreasing speed and may stop.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.6 (p.17)

questions.question: When parking an automatic car, which gear position do you select before switching off?
questions.explanation: Stopping for parking (automatic): apply parking brake, select "P", then switch off.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 32 (p.53)

questions.question: Put these steps for entering a freeway in the correct order.

options.text: Yield in accordance with the traffic pattern and signs
Select the appropriate lane of the on-ramp
Check rear-view mirror(s) and appropriate blind spot
Merge with traffic and obtain sufficient clear space

questions.explanation: LMV Module 53 sets out these steps (with accelerating/decelerating as necessary).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 53 (p.74)

questions.question: Which of these is a heavy motor vehicle (HMV)? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: A motor car with a tare of 1 200 kg and no trailer
A vehicle with a tare exceeding 3 500 kg
A combination where the trailer's GVM exceeds 750 kg
A goods vehicle with a GVM exceeding 3 500 kg

questions.explanation: HMV includes vehicles with a tare over 3 500 kg; minibuses, buses or goods vehicles with a GVM over 3 500 kg; and combinations where the drawing vehicle's GCM exceeds 3 500 kg or the trailer's GVM exceeds 750 kg.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.9)–10

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Animal-drawn vehicles prohibited (R237).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R237 (p.15)

questions.question: After the licence disc expires, there is a grace period during which the vehicle may still be used on a public road. How long is it?
questions.explanation: A motor vehicle may, within a period of 21 days after the date of expiry, still be operated on a public road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.8 (p.15)

questions.question: A container with provision for "twist locks" must be secured with at least how many twist locks?
questions.explanation: A container with provision for twist locks must be securely fastened by at least four twist locks.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.33 (p.25)

questions.question: If the wheels lock during an emergency stop, what should you do?

options.text: Release pressure on the brake pedal as necessary

questions.explanation: The driver shall release pressure on the brake pedal as necessary if the wheels should lock.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 56 (p.77)

questions.question: You should change to a lower gear to help the brakes slow the car down.
questions.explanation: A lower gear shall not be selected to replace or assist braking; braking shall be completed before selecting a lower gear.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Braking (p.79)

questions.question: Which licence code covers light motor vehicles with a mass not exceeding 3 500 kg?
questions.explanation: A code 2 learner's licence authorises the driving of light motor vehicles (tare/GVM not more than 3 500 kg).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.1 (p.12); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.9)

questions.question: Goods carried on a motorcycle may not project more than how far on either side of the wheels?
questions.explanation: Goods on a motorcycle may not project more than 450 mm on either side of the wheels (300 mm beyond the sidecar wheel).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.35 (p.26)

questions.question: This is an urban road with a side road (intersection). Click on the car that is parked illegally.
questions.explanation: In an urban area you may not park within 5 m of any intersection. Car B is within 5 m of the side road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.47 (p.31)

questions.question: A motorcycle must have which of these at the rear? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: A motorcycle must have a red rear lamp, a stop lamp and a red retro-reflector at the rear.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.43 (p.29); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.5 (p.17)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrian priority area (max 15 km/h for permitted vehicles)

questions.explanation: Pedestrian priority (R5): priority to pedestrians; only emergency, loading/off-loading and maintenance vehicles may enter, at a maximum of 15 km/h.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R5 (p.5)

questions.question: What must you do at this signal?

options.text: Speed up before it turns red
Treat it as a four-way stop
Drive on carefully, but yield to pedestrians

questions.explanation: Flashing amber disc: drive on carefully, but yield to pedestrians; pedestrians may cross.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §8 Traffic signals (p.56)

questions.question: What does "decelerate" mean in the K53 manual?

options.text: Reducing speed by releasing the accelerator only

questions.explanation: Decelerate: causing a vehicle to reduce speed by releasing the accelerator only.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Decelerate (p.80)

questions.question: Seatbelt rules for children cover persons ____ years of age and older.
questions.explanation: Seatbelts are compulsory for persons 3 years of age and older.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.17 (p.20)

questions.question: A stop line on its own (without a stop sign) has the same meaning as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Stop line (RTM1): if there is no stop sign, the stop line has the same meaning as a stop sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RTM1 (p.48)

questions.question: Which sign gives pedestrians priority and limits vehicles to 15 km/h?
questions.explanation: Pedestrian priority (R5): red diamond with a pedestrian; permitted vehicles may drive at a maximum of 15 km/h.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R5 (p.5)

questions.question: Which number shows the gear lever in this manual-transmission car?
questions.explanation: The gear lever is number 6.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: Which controls are used to see what is to the rear and sides of the vehicle? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: The centre rear-view mirror (1) and the left and right rear-view mirrors (3).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: What is the minimum following distance for a heavy motor vehicle in normal conditions?
questions.explanation: Maintain a minimum 3-second following distance for heavy motor vehicles.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.49 (p.32)

questions.question: The steering wheel should not be turned while the vehicle is ____.
questions.explanation: Do not turn the steering wheel whilst the vehicle is stationary.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 14 (p.30)

questions.question: A light motor vehicle (LMV) is a vehicle whose tare/GVM does not exceed…
questions.explanation: "LMV" means a light motor vehicle of which the tare/GVM is not more than 3 500 kg.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.9)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Pay toll ahead (last chance to take the alternative route)

questions.explanation: Motor cars only (R117): only motor cars may use this road or part of the road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R117 (p.7)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Towed vehicles prohibited (no towing beyond this sign)
Hitch-hiking prohibited (no picking up for 500 m)
Motorcycles prohibited (on a freeway, leave at the first exit)

questions.explanation: Motorcycles prohibited (R222): motorcyclists may not enter; on a freeway they must leave at the first exit.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R222 (p.13)

questions.question: Match each regulatory sign shown to what it means.

options.text: Pedestrian priority area (max 15 km/h for permitted vehicles)
4-way stop: the vehicle that stopped first moves off first
Temporary STOP/GO control: you may proceed with caution

questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R1.5: Temporary STOP/GO control: you may proceed with caution. Sign 2 is R6: Yield to oncoming traffic. Sign 3 is R5: Pedestrian priority area (max 15 km/h for permitted vehicles). Sign 4 is R1.4: 4-way stop: the vehicle that stopped first moves off first.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R1.5 (p.4), R6 (p.5), R5 (p.5), R1.4 (p.4)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Sharp curve to the right"?
questions.explanation: Sharp curve (W204/W205): slow down to take the curve safely.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W204 (p.25)

questions.question: Which number shows the clutch in this manual-transmission car?
questions.explanation: The clutch is number 8.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Proceed right only (R106): drive only in the direction indicated by the arrow.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R106 (p.6)

questions.question: Match the numbered controls to their names.
questions.explanation: 2 = Window wiper. 5 = Indicator light switch. 7 = Hand brake (parking brake). 9 = Brake.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: Put these freeway exit signs in the order you pass them, starting furthest from the off-ramp.
questions.explanation: GA1 about 2 km before, GA2 about 1 km, GA2/3 about 500 m, GA3 as close as possible to the off-ramp.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §5.2 GA1–GA3 (p.42)

questions.question: Where this sign is displayed, drivers may not pick up passengers for the next ____.
questions.explanation: Hitch-hiking prohibited (R207): a driver may not pick up passengers for the next 500 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R207 (p.11)

questions.question: What is the "parking brake" of a vehicle?

options.text: A brake used only when towing
A brake, normally a hand brake, used to keep the vehicle stationary

questions.explanation: "Parking brake" means a brake, normally a hand brake, used in the ordinary course of events to keep a vehicle stationary.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.7)

questions.question: What colour light must a rear lamp show?
questions.explanation: Rear lamps must emit a red light to the rear.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.5 (p.17)

questions.question: Match each regulatory sign shown to what it means.

options.text: Only vehicles with a GVM/GCM above the mass shown (10 t) may use this road

questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R102: Only vehicles with a GVM/GCM above the mass shown (10 t) may use this road. Sign 2 is R133: Switch headlamps on (dipped). Sign 3 is R131: Animal-drawn vehicles only. Sign 4 is R118: Taxis only.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R102 (p.6), R133 (p.10), R131 (p.9), R118 (p.7)

questions.question: What is "clear space"?

options.text: Areas around the vehicle that allow room to take evasive action if necessary
The empty boot of the car
The space between the driver and the steering wheel

questions.explanation: Clear space is the area surrounding the vehicle allowing manoeuvring room for evasive action; ensure it when passing, overtaking, following, merging or stopping.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Clear space (p.79)

questions.question: Checking the steering for excessive free play is part of the interior pre-trip inspection.
questions.explanation: Pre-trip inspection (interior) includes checking the steering for excessive free play.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 2 (p.18)

questions.question: If no seat with a seatbelt is available for a child, the driver must make sure the child sits on the rear seat, if the vehicle has one.
questions.explanation: If a seat with a seatbelt is not available, the child shall be seated on the rear seat if the vehicle has one.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.17.1 (p.21)

questions.question: A tractor is exempt from the requirement to have a rear-view mirror.
questions.explanation: The rear-view mirror requirement does not apply in respect of a tractor.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.11 (p.18)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?
questions.explanation: Hawkers prohibited (R241): do not stop or park for hawkers where this sign is displayed.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R241 (p.15)

questions.question: Resting your hand on the gear-lever knob while driving is an acceptable steering method.
questions.explanation: Resting a hand on the gear-lever knob is given as an example of a steering method fault.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 14 (p.30)

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the parking area?

options.text: Parking for vehicles under 3 500 kg, no time limit, but a fee is payable

questions.explanation: R305-P: parking area for vehicles with a GVM of less than 3 500 kg where no time limit applies but a fee must be paid.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.4 R305-P (p.16)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Reserved for ambulances/emergency vehicles"?
questions.explanation: Ambulance/emergency vehicle reservation (R321).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.4 R321 (p.18)

questions.question: What should you do at this sign?

options.text: Speed up to pass before children arrive
Stop only if a police officer is present
Slow down and look out for a stop sign displayed by the scholar patrol

questions.explanation: Scholar patrol ahead (TW305): slow down and look out for a stop sign displayed by the scholar patrol and for children.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 TW305 (p.27)

questions.question: Sign W327 means that only one vehicle at a time can pass through the structure ahead.
questions.explanation: One vehicle width structure (W327).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W327 (p.29)

questions.question: Your truck is 4,6 m high. What must you do when you see this sign?
questions.explanation: Height limit (R204): if your vehicle or load is higher than the height indicated, another road must be used.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R204 (p.11)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Parking reserved for buses"?
questions.explanation: Bus parking reservation (R301-P): only buses may park in the area indicated.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.4 R301-P (p.16)

questions.question: Which number shows the hand brake (parking brake) in this manual-transmission car?
questions.explanation: The hand brake (parking brake) is number 7.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: Which of these disqualifies a person from obtaining a learner's licence? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Addiction to a drug having a narcotic effect

questions.explanation: Disqualifications include drug/alcohol addiction, uncontrolled epilepsy or diabetes, and similar conditions; deafness alone is not a disqualifying defect.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – §4.1 Disqualification (p.11–12)

questions.question: This signal is flashing at a railway crossing. What does it mean?

options.text: Stop, then cross if you cannot see a train
A train is coming – do not drive on until it stops flashing
The crossing is out of order

questions.explanation: At a railway crossing a flashing red light indicates that a train is coming and you may not drive on until the light stops flashing.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §8 Traffic signals (p.56)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Reserved for high-occupancy vehicles"?
questions.explanation: High-occupancy vehicle reservation (R320).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.4 R320 (p.17)

questions.question: When may a motor car enter a dedicated public transport lane during its operating hours? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: When directed by a traffic officer
To enter or leave adjacent premises
To turn at the next intersection or off-ramp

questions.explanation: Other vehicles may enter a dedicated lane only to enter/leave premises or a road, to turn at the next intersection, on-ramp or off-ramp, or on a traffic officer's or sign's direction.
questions.manualRef: National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000, Reg 296A

questions.question: By how much may the load of a goods vehicle with a GVM over 12 000 kg project from the longitudinal centre-line on either side?
questions.explanation: Projection from the centre-line: 1,3 m for a bus or goods vehicle over 12 000 kg GVM (max width 2,6 m); 1,25 m for any other vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.35 (p.26)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Excessive noise prohibited (no hooting for 100 m)
Towed vehicles prohibited (no towing beyond this sign)

questions.explanation: Right turn ahead prohibited (R210): do not turn right at the intersection ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R210 (p.12)

questions.question: What is the difference between these two signs?

options.text: "No parking" allows stopping briefly; "no stopping" does not allow stopping at all

questions.explanation: R216 prohibits parking; R217 prohibits stopping except to obey a signal/officer or avoid a collision.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R217 (p.12)

questions.question: Which control is used to clean the front windscreen of the vehicle?
questions.explanation: The window wiper (2).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: The handgrips of a motorcycle may be higher than 500 mm above the seat height.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle may not be used if the outer ends of the handgrips are higher than 500 mm above the seat height, or lower than the seat height.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.12 (p.19)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Heavy vehicles may not overtake other heavy vehicles (500 m)"?
questions.explanation: R215: drivers of heavy motor vehicles may not overtake other heavy vehicles (for the next 500 m).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R215 (p.12)

questions.question: In which exclusive parking bay may any driver stop or park in an emergency?
questions.explanation: Exclusive parking bay (RM7): in an emergency you may stop or park at the sign that indicates the SOS telephone.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM7 (p.50)

questions.question: In this automatic car, which control do you use to accelerate?
questions.explanation: Control 10 is the accelerator.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Holding a cellphone between your shoulder and ear while driving is allowed because your hands are free.
questions.explanation: The prohibition covers holding a device in one or both hands or with any other part of the body.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.52 (p.34); National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000, Reg 308A

questions.question: Tap the steering wheel in this automatic-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The steering wheel is control 4.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: When passing oncoming traffic, what must you ensure?

options.text: That you drive on the shoulder
That your vehicle does not encroach on the right-hand side in a way that obstructs or endangers it

questions.explanation: When passing oncoming traffic, do not encroach on the roadway to your right so as to obstruct or endanger it.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.45 (p.29)

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign at the entrance to a narrow road?

options.text: Speed up to clear the section before oncoming traffic arrives
Hoot to warn oncoming traffic and proceed
Stop and wait for a traffic officer
Yield to vehicles already in the single carriageway

questions.explanation: Yield to oncoming traffic (R6): a single carriageway is used from both directions; yield to vehicles already in it.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R6 (p.5)

questions.question: What is the "kerb line"?

options.text: The centre line of the road
The boundary between the shoulder and the verge (or between the roadway edge and the verge where there is no shoulder)
The yellow line on the left
The edge of the sidewalk furthest from the road

questions.explanation: "Kerb line" means the boundary between the shoulder and the verge or, absent a shoulder, between the edge of the roadway and the verge.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.5)

questions.question: What is the centre rear-view mirror used for?

options.text: To increase the speed of the vehicle
To see what is to the rear of the vehicle
To clean the front windscreen (e.g. when driving in the rain)

questions.explanation: The centre rear-view mirror is used to see what is to the rear of the vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: A learner's licence holder may drive a vehicle of a class that needs a professional driving permit if accompanied by a registered professional driver for that class.
questions.explanation: The professional driving permit requirement does not apply to a learner's licence holder accompanied by a person registered as a professional driver for that class of vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.7)

questions.question: What must a motorcycle's protective helmet comply with? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: The chin strap must be fastened under the chin
It must be designed for use with a motorcycle

questions.explanation: The helmet must be specially designed for use with the cycle, fit properly and have the chin strap properly fastened under the chin.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.18 (p.21)

questions.question: In an automatic car, when should manual gear selection normally be necessary?

options.text: When a lower gear is required to negotiate a steep decline

questions.explanation: Manual selection should only be necessary if a lower gear is required to negotiate a steep decline.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 25 (p.46)

questions.question: You may drive on the shoulder of the road at night while being overtaken.
questions.explanation: Driving on the shoulder is only allowed between sunrise and sunset (and while being overtaken, if safe).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.39 (p.28)

questions.question: You see this sign and a collision has already happened ahead, with enough help on the scene. What should you do?

options.text: Concentrate on the route and do not stop out of curiosity
Stop to look at the wreckage

questions.explanation: Collision (TW353): if there is enough or professional help on the scene, do not stop out of curiosity.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 TW353 (p.32)

questions.question: Which number shows the steering wheel in this manual-transmission car?
questions.explanation: The steering wheel is number 4.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Delineator plate: do not pass to the left of it
T-junction chevron: road does not continue straight
Dead end: turn left or right

questions.explanation: Dead-end (W410): the road does not continue beyond the sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W410 (p.34)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Side road junction from the right

questions.explanation: Side road from the right (W108): traffic may approach from the right.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.1 W108 (p.23)

questions.question: Which meaning belongs to each regulatory sign? Match them.
questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R123: Goods vehicles only. Sign 2 is R110: Pedestrians only. Sign 3 is R117: Motor cars only. Sign 4 is R109: Turn right ahead only.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R123 (p.8), R110 (p.6), R117 (p.7), R109 (p.6)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Combined curves: first sharp curve to the left"?
questions.explanation: Combined curves (W211): two sharp curves in opposite directions, the first to the left.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W211 (p.25)

questions.question: What does this road marking mean?
questions.explanation: Pedestrian crossing (RTM3/RTM4): give pedestrians priority.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RTM3 (p.48)

questions.question: You approach this sign and there is no stop line painted on the road. Where must you stop?

options.text: With the front of the vehicle in line with the stop sign
At the edge of the intersecting road's kerb line, past the sign
Anywhere within 10 m of the sign
Only if other traffic is approaching

questions.explanation: Stop sign (R1.1): if there is no stop line, the front of the vehicle must come to a standstill in line with the stop sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R1 (p.4)

questions.question: You may overtake another vehicle on a single-lane on-ramp to a freeway.
questions.explanation: Do not overtake on a single-lane on-ramp (or off-ramp).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 53 (p.74)

questions.question: The rider of a motorcycle must ensure that a passenger younger than ____ years wears a protective helmet.
questions.explanation: The rider shall ensure any passenger younger than 14 years wears a protective helmet.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.18 (p.21)

questions.question: What is the minimum age to obtain a code 1 (motorcycle) learner's licence?
questions.explanation: To obtain a code 1 learner's licence you must be at least 16 years of age.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.1 (p.12)

questions.question: When entering a freeway, which blind spots must you check?
questions.explanation: A left and right blind spot check shall be done upon entering a freeway.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 53 (p.74)

questions.question: A passenger on your motorcycle is 12 years old. Who must make sure the passenger wears a protective helmet?

options.text: Nobody – helmets are optional for children

questions.explanation: A motorcycle rider must ensure that a passenger younger than 14 years wears a protective helmet.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.18 (p.21)

questions.question: Some vehicles have a foot-operated parking brake.
questions.explanation: Some vehicles might have the hand brake as a foot-operated control (e.g. Mercedes-Benz).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)
